g.text: One 25.055-µs example: lower pixel error can coincide with visibly depleted toroidal structure
Radial–toroidal plane at fixed poloidal index y=16. Predictions are pointwise medians over the three independently trained seeds; nonlinear metrics were computed seed by seed.
